tool_args.rationale: A finer trajectory batch can distinguish coupled dynamics from an additive sink-plus-adaptation law before committing to a long-horizon forecast.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a sink-inhibited base plus dual-horizon adaptation immediately
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The eight observations establish a long-horizon reversal, but the short-horizon measurements confound input, sink gradient, and time; they do not uniquely identify how the sink and adaptation are coupled.
The acquired probe already covers H = 8–24.9, including reversal near the target horizon.
It does not resolve the mechanism ambiguity.
